product: READ METADATA privilege support for compliance security profile standards
tagline: The READ METADATA privilege now supports all compliance security profile standards supported by Databricks and is available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled.
what_it_does: The READ METADATA privilege now supports all compliance security profile standards supported by Databricks and is available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled. For a full list of supported compliance standards, see Compliance security profile. This page describes the compliance security profile, its compliance controls, and supported features.
